message.title: Welcome!
message.body: Thank you for visiting my test world! This world is in its early design phase. For an example of what the final product might look like, check out City of Glass 2. Changelog: • Improved Gamepad controls on PC & Phone • Sun now has physically-based light colour! • Added UI light/dark skins and collapsible menus • Fixed being able to look backward while wallrunning
